notes.title: Developments so far
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. As you know for a while, I've been working on a brand new software for Stay Alive. The new software is progressing towards both fixing the old messy code and making it perform higher, as well as making the game available for co-op.

As you know, I will be releasing another game before the final release of Stay Alive, so I plan to both generate revenue for some models and test the smooth operation of new systems.

Below is the list of works done in the game so far. These will also be available and tested in the next game:

-Matching of thousands of objects even for players far from each other
-Ability to move objects by placing them on top of each other
-Inventory system*
-A new "group creation and management" system**
-A smoother working pathfinder system
-In-game conversation, correspondence opportunities
-New game save system
-Owning a building and changing the materials of its rooms
-Revamped graphics
-Dynamic, visual and sensory ambience change system
-Dynamic performance enhancing systems
-Possibility to enter every visible house

*The inventory system will be different for stay alive. Instead of the old system, each item will have a capacity in width and height (like Tarkov)
**This system will be used for establishing a company in the next game. It will be used for clan creation and inter-clan relations for Stay Alive.


The following systems are complete but will not be in the next game:

-Synchronization of moving objects
-Fix player specific floating point issues for each far away player
-Dynamic weather changes and weather events
-Modable objects

All these systems work with full synchronization between all players and full synchronization is available for players who enter the game later.



What more will be added to Stay Alive:

-Remodeling of buildings
-Remodeling of vehicles
-Remodeling of objects
-Creating the map
-Coding of NPC dialogue system and reactions
-Modable objects, npc dialogs, buildings
-Twitch Integration
-Zombies
-Weapons and explosions
-Survival systems such as water filling



The release date is not clear, but I will continue to inform you here. Stay tuned.

Mehan Games

notes.title: About Stay Alive
notes.notes:
Hello after a very long time.

Of course, everyone has had a hard time lately. Corona, our losses, economic crises, unfortunate events, personal problems... I won't bother you with my real life problems, but I apologize to everyone for not being able to deal with Stay Alive for a long time due to these problems and not responding to incoming messages. But I can assure you that Stay Alive has not been abandoned.

During this time, some developments took place. I created brand new software for Stay Alive. With the new software, I am making the game suitable for multiplayer. For now, the general systems are ready and major issues have been resolved, but I decided to remake many models and maps, especially buildings, for better performance, better visuals and more fluid gameplay.

The game will go to the full version with the next update. Of course, this update will be coming after a long time. I can't give an exact release date. I'd also like to release another game before the full version of Stay Alive is released, to check that the systems are working properly, and to budget a bit.

The price of the game has been updated and there will be no discounts for a long time. Thank you to everyone who bought the game in early access and supported it. Thanks to you, Mehan Games has developed and will continue to grow.

Mehan Games

notes.title: Future Plans and Thanks for Support
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone. I hope your day is going well.

Stay Alive: Apocalypse has been released a month ago. In this one month, eight updates were made and a lot of features came.

Some of you remember the first times in the game. The save games are problematic, the buildings are became invisible, using the vehicles is a complete torture... The list goes on. Most of issues have now been fixed. This was happen with your help. Thank you.

Of course there are still bugs and I hope that they will fixed in time. As you know, there are many systems in the game. I do updates on continuous systems and this affects other systems as well. Something that works can be bugged later on. Unfortunately, after every system change, it is impossible to test the whole game from start to finish. I also thank you for your patience in this regard.

In this announcement I wanted to give more information about the game. First of all, if you think that the price of the game is expensive, I have to make some explanations. I will not take refuge on a pretext like there are much less featured but more expensive games. The price of the game was determined by considering discounts (just like all other games).

However, the main purpose of the price is: some of the income will spend in the development of the game. Unfortunately, it is not possible for me to handle everything alone. I am planning to have more professional people pay for work that is difficult or time consuming for me. (NPC models, qualitiy textures, professional sound effects, quality animations ...) Thank you for your understanding in this matter.

Although uncertain, I also think about kickstarter project. I will announce on this in the future.

If all the plans go smoothly, at the beginning of 2019, I hope Stay Alive will literally be a "real survival game".

Thanks again for your help and support. (Sorry for bad english)
